Item 1A. Risk Factors

Supply Chain and Foundry Concentration
We rely on a limited number of third-party semiconductor foundries located in Taiwan to fabricate our custom AI accelerators. Any geopolitical disruption, export restriction, or natural disaster affecting these suppliers’ facilities could delay product shipments and materially harm our revenue.

Cyber­security and Service Availability
Our cloud platform processes sensitive enterprise workloads.​ A prolonged outage or unauthorized data access incident could result in regulatory fines, customer attrition, and reputational damage.

Customer Concentration
In fiscal 2025, our two largest hyperscale customers accounted for 34% of total consolidated revenue, and neither customer has a long-term minimum purchase commitment.

Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Overview and Growth Drivers
Consolidated revenue increased 24% year-over-year in fiscal 2025, driven primarily by “accelerated enterprise adoption” of our multi-region inference platform and higher net dollar retention among large enterprise cohorts.

Liquidity and Working Capital Commentary
During the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025, we extended payment terms for select strategic distributors from 45 days to 90 days, which contributed to an expansion in accounts receivable faster than revenue growth.

Outlook
Management continues to invest in next-generation data center capacity while monitoring component lead times and power availability.
